To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the antibiotic activity of the lincosamides is dependent on the configuration of the sugar and the pyrolidine ring, and the activity of the streptogramins is dependent on the presence of a macrocyclic lacton ring and a 13 OH function.
the structure of the lincosamides can be altered without loss of biological activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the structure-activity relationship of lincosamides and streptogramins.
the structure activity relationships of lincosamides and streptogramins and the development of new molecules with improved pharmacological and pharmacokinetic properties.
the synthesis and evaluation of new analogs of the lincosamides and streptogramins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a wide variety of structural changes can be made on these molecules with retention of the antibiotic activity of the parent compound.
the antibiotic activity resides in the sugar moiety for the lincosamides and in the peptolide for the streptogramins.
the antibiotic activity of the lincosamides is due to the configuration of the 6 amino,6 deoxy octapyranose with the thiogolycolate moiety in the a position.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the antibiotic activity of lincosamides is strongly dependent on the configuration of the asymmetric centers of the sugar moiety and the presence of the thioglycine moiety in the beta position.
the antibiotic activity of the streptogramins is due to the presence of the 13 OH group and the macrocycle.

the antibiotic activity of lincosamide antibiotics is dependent on the presence of the thioglycoside moiety in the 6 amino,6 deoxy sugar residue, the configuration of the sugar residue, the presence of the 7 hydroxyl group and the pyrolidine ring moiety.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a large number of modifications of the streptogramin structure can be made without a significant loss of activity.
the structure of the molecules is not critical as long as the essential functions are retained.
a wide variety of chemical structures are capable of exhibiting the same biological properties.
